title: From Public Evidence to Contractual Outcome: First and Stable Decidability on Kalshi
abstract: arXiv:2609.16642v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Public evidence can become sufficient to settle a prediction-market contract before the venue records its first determination, but the relevant boundary depends on the applicable rule version, exact release object, source hierarchy, correction history, and unfinished contract conditions. This paper defines two Kalshi clocks: first decidability, the earliest contemporaneous singleton in the rule-evidence mapping, and stable decidability, the retrospective earliest time after which the same singleton remains unchanged through finalization. A completed retrospective identification test establishes a narrow feasibility result. In a frozen blind pilot, all 25 identities and blinding checks passed and current rule text was recovered for all 25; no exact or bounded historical rule version and no exact or bounded official source-release object was recovered. translated_title: 从公开证据到合约结果：Kalshi平台上的首次可判定性与稳定可判定性
translated_abstract: 公开证据可以在交易场所记录其首次判定之前，就变得足以结算一份预测市场合约，但相关的判定边界取决于适用的规则版本、确切的发布对象、信息来源层级、更正历史以及尚未完成的合约条件。本文定义了两个“Kalshi时钟”：首次可判定性，即规则-证据映射中最早的同期单例时间点；以及稳定可判定性，即回溯意义上最早的时间点，此后同一单例在合约最终结算前保持不变。一项已完成的回溯性识别测试建立了一个范围有限的可行性结果。在一项冻结盲测试点中，全部25个身份识别与盲测检查均通过，且全部25个案例的现行规则文本均被成功恢复；但没有任何确切的或有界的历史规则版本被恢复，也没有任何确切的或有界的官方来源发布对象被恢复。完整的历史恢复工作覆盖了152,694个普通合约代码、11,530个确切事件识别（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文为预测市场Kalshi定义了“首次可判定性”与“稳定可判定性”两个时钟概念，证明公开证据可在平台正式判定之前即足以结算合约，并通过冻结盲测试点验证了回溯性识别测试的狭窄可行性，同时揭示了历史规则版本与官方发布对象无法被完全恢复的局限。
en_tdlr: This paper defines two "Kalshi clocks"—first decidability and stable decidability—demonstrating that public evidence can suffice to settle a prediction-market contract before the venue's first determination, and a frozen blind pilot establishes a narrow retrospective identification feasibility result despite the unrecoverability of exact historical rule versions and official source-release objects.
